name: People Judging You
overview: Scripture warns believers against harsh or superficial judgment, urging them to avoid condemning others lest they themselves face judgment, as emphasized in Matthew 7:1 and Luke 6:37. Instead, John 7:24 encourages discerning with righteous judgment rather than by outward appearances. The Psalms and Proverbs remind us to seek God's guidance and exercise prudence, covering shame rather than reacting impulsively. Ecclesiastes also advises guarding the heart against every spoken word, recognizing that some judgments may be unfair or hurtful.
